subject.title: fix(tasks): reset omitted lifecycle start time

question: Should OpenClaw now reject malformed bundled-plugin and direct-host lifecycle starts that omit a finite producer timestamp?
rationale: This is a deliberate fail-closed change at a shared event and plugin API boundary; tests establish correctness for supported producers, but accepting the compatibility break and completing the mandatory exact Codex contract check require maintainer authority.

options.title: Enforce the strict contract
options.body: Confirm that malformed lifecycle starts are unsupported, complete the exact Codex source check, refresh the branch, and land the current fail-closed behavior.

options.title: Preserve malformed compatibility
options.body: Require a redesign that keeps existing plugin calls apparently accepted while preventing stale durable timestamps, with explicit compatibility tests and a defined migration or deprecation path.

recommendation.title: Enforce the strict contract
recommendation.body: Confirm that malformed lifecycle starts are unsupported, complete the exact Codex source check, refresh the branch, and land the current fail-closed behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans common agent-event admission, bundled-plugin behavior, and durable task state, matching recent broad agent-runtime ownership.
